description: This file contains the definition of the class Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler, which is responsible for compiling Smarty templates into PHP code. It includes methods for initializing the compiler, performing the compilation process, registering and unregistering post-compile callbacks, and managing internal parsing and tokenization processes.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler
classes.description: The class responsible for compiling Smarty templates into executable PHP code, handling lexer/parser interaction, callback registration, and post-processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler class with specified lexer and parser classes, and a Smarty object.

methods.name: doCompile
methods.description: Performs the compilation of a Smarty template source into PHP code, managing tokenization, parsing, and callback invocation.

methods.name: registerPostCompileCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked after the template is compiled.

methods.name: unregisterPostCompileCallback
methods.description: Removes a previously registered post-compile callback by key.
